# Propeller replacement

Fixture for the RAG tutorial test. KESTREL-4 is a fictional aircraft; values are illustrative.

## Prerequisites

Remove the flight battery before you touch the propeller. An unexpected motor start can cause serious injury.

## Installation

Place the new propeller on the motor shaft, printed side forward. Hold the propeller hub and torque the self-locking nut to 4.5 N·m ± 0.2.

## Follow-on maintenance

Perform the pre-flight motor run-up check and record the new propeller serial number in the aircraft logbook.
